target.outcome: Cumulative COVID-19 deaths in hospitals through 2020-05-01
target.effect_scale: Rate ratio per 1 microgram per cubic metre PM2.5
target.exposure_assignment: Unweighted polygon zonal mean of 18 annual NASA PM2.5 rasters
target.model: NB2 count regression with log department population offset
covariates: combined resuscitation and intensive-care beds per 100k
target.named_outcome_source: French Ministry of Health / Santé publique France data.gouv hospital COVID dataset

substitutions.reanalysis: WorldClim v2.1 BIO1 climatological department mean; centroid-cell fallback for Paris
substitutions.reason: Exact article temperature aggregation was not recovered; complete public climatology is retained and explicitly classified as a substitution.

coverage.rule: Include departments with complete outcomes, covariates, and all 18 required annual PM2.5 slices.
coverage.notes: All 96 departments met this rule. PM2.5 is 18/18 years for every unit.

blockers: Exact article-stated WorldClim 2001–2012 temperature aggregation was not recovered; the temperature covariate is a declared source/time-window substitution.

design_provenance.geographic_representation: 96 geoBoundaries France ADM2 department polygons (official IGN source stated in GeoBoundaries metadata); all mainland departments.
design_provenance.assignment_method: Unweighted zonal mean over every valid 0.01-degree PM2.5 grid cell whose center falls in each department polygon; no monitor assignment.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.source_strategy: NASA Earthdata ImageServer public multidimensional Global Annual PM2.5 Grids (V4.GL.03), explicitly selecting each 1999–2016 annual slice; WorldClim v2.1 BIO1 used for temperature adjustment.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: Arithmetic mean of 18 department annual PM2.5 zonal means, 1999–2016, µg/m³.

coverage_policy.evidence: Report-only: retain departments with all 18 valid annual PM2.5 means. WorldClim 10-arcminute cell containing the centroid is used only for Paris because its polygon contains no 10-arcminute cell center.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: This directly implements the article's GOME/NASA SEDAC 1999–2016 department-level spatial mean construct using a maintained public NASA Earthdata distribution. It does not use author-published PM2.5 values. The covariate temperature source is a WorldClim climatology rather than the article-stated 2001–2012 aggregation, so that covariate substitution is declared separately.
evidence_basis: NASA ImageServer metadata identifies the public global annual PM2.5 raster service, WGS84, 0.01-degree pixels, annual temporal dimension.
Independent zonal processing yielded 18/18 annual PM2.5 values for each of 96 departments; output includes mean/range and temperature coverage.
GeoBoundaries metadata reports France ADM2/Department, official IGN source, and 96 units.
